record.paper_title: Advances and Open Problems in Federated Learning
record.original_question: For production cross-silo federated learning, how can systems handle coordination across many organizations, including heterogeneous data generation and labeling, incompatible software stacks, jurisdiction-dependent data-use approvals, policy-enforcing infrastructure, vertical feature partitioning, entity alignment, and missing features?

artifact.status_search_result: Cross-silo federated learning with heterogeneous stacks, jurisdictional policies, vertical partitioning, private entity alignment, and missing features is widely treated as an open systems and algorithms research direction. Surveys and follow-up works since 2021 (e.g., on vertical FL, private set intersection for entity resolution, and policy-aware FL frameworks) report progress on individual components but no unified system delivering all requirements with formal guarantees has been established.

status_evidence.title: Advances and Open Problems in Federated Learning
status_evidence.snippet: Lists cross-silo coordination, vertical FL, entity alignment, and policy enforcement among open challenges.
status_evidence.claim: Identifies these cross-silo coordination problems as open.

status_evidence.title: A Survey on Vertical Federated Learning
status_evidence.snippet: Recent surveys note that private entity alignment, missing-feature handling, and system heterogeneity remain unsolved in production VFL.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent surveys confirm the problem remains open.
